title: Clothesline Clues to Jobs People Do
author: Kathleen Heling & Deborah Hembrook

hero.name: Clothesline with hanging clothes
hero.description: A backyard clothesline with various work uniforms and clothing items hanging on it, representing the book's central guessing-game concept
hero.source_note: Generic clothesline image — search Boardmaker for 'clothesline' or 'laundry line'; if unavailable, source simple clip art of clothes hanging on a line

ambiguous.issue: Could mean winter/fashion gloves or work/medical/protective gloves
ambiguous.reason: Book features protective and occupational gloves worn as part of job uniforms (e.g. chef, astronaut, nurse)

notes: This book uses a clothesline guessing-game format where children identify community helper jobs from clothing clues. The existing activity_images already include 'clothes', 'hat', 'doctor', 'chef', 'mail', 'painter', 'farmer', 'police', and aac_extras include 'job', 'tools', 'work', 'uniform' — so 'uniform' in fringe_11 can reuse the existing aac_extras icon. 'Chef' is already in activity_images and can be reused. 'Mail carrier' can leverage the existing 'mail' icon with a carrier/person modifier if needed. Fringe prioritises the jobs featured in the book (nurse, firefighter, astronaut, chef, mail carrier, scientist, teacher) plus key clothing/equipment items (helmet, gloves, apron, uniform) that are central to the guessing-game vocabulary. The core row already provides 'colour' and 'read' which support discussion of clothing colours and reading the clues. 'Doctor' and 'painter' and 'farmer' and 'police' from existing activity_images are relevant secondary jobs in the book and can be added to supplemental activity sheets even though they are not on the main fringe.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap
